description:
## Why

After PKIX-lwr9.6 wired the limbo harness through `pkix_path_builder::build_path` (2026-05-11), the original 47-case StricterThanWild bucket collapsed to 26 residuals, of which only **one** is a genuine pkix-path-builder bug:

* `bettertls::pathbuilding::tc60` — depth-6 chain, corpus expects SUCCESS (`ground_truth_agreement=false`), pkix-path-builder selects a wrong intermediate at depth 3, signature verification fails at chain index 3.

The other 6 residual `bettertls::pathbuilding::*` cases (tc8/tc15/tc41/tc47/tc74/tc80) all have `gt_agreement=true` — pkix-path correctly rejects what the corpus expects to fail. They are not builder bugs; they are correct strictness (legacy ECDSA-with-SHA1 OID not dispatched, or signature linkage genuinely broken in negative-test bundles).

This bead was originally framed around ~10 cases ('signature invalid at chain index 5/6' + 2 non-CA-at-depth-6). Empirical re-baseline shows the only residual at any depth-5/6 boundary is tc60 (single case, depth-6 chain, sig invalid at index 3 not 5/6).

## What

1. Add a regression test fixture in `pkix-path-builder/tests/fixtures/bettertls/` for tc60 specifically (its PEM payloads from `limbo.json`).
2. Diagnose why the builder picks the wrong intermediate at depth 3. Likely candidates:
   - the chosen candidate has matching SubjectDN but the AKI/SKI hint points elsewhere
   - alternative sibling intermediate exists in the bundle but is not enumerated as a backtracking option
   - depth-3 candidate is the right shape positionally but signs with a key that does not match depth-4's TBS-issuer linkage
3. Fix the builder to enumerate alternative candidates at depth 3 when the first choice signature-fails.
4. Re-run the limbo baseline; tc60 should flip from StricterThanWild(Fail) to Agreement(Pass).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Regression test for tc60 in `pkix-path-builder/tests/`.
- [ ] tc60 flips to Agreement in `baseline-limbo.json` post-fix.
- [ ] StricterThanWild count drops from 26 to 25 (or fewer, if related cases surface).
- [ ] No regression on PKITS or other limbo cases.

## Out of scope

- The other 6 residual `bettertls::pathbuilding::*` cases (gt_agreement=true; pkix-path correctly stricter — see baseline-limbo-analysis.md).
- The 4 `online::*` P-384 cases (PKIX-wmch, harness limitation not builder).
- The 10 `bettertls::nameconstraints` malformed-cert cases (pkix-path correctly stricter).

## Filed by

Re-scoped from original ~10-case framing to tc60-only by PKIX-lwr9.6 re-baseline (2026-05-11).
